svg.text: ESP32-C3 SuperMini to the u-blox 7 board
Both boards seen from their component side, SuperMini USB-C up. Pin order is as on the GPS board; see the notes.
Supply: 3.3 V. Default UART speed: 9600 baud.
ESP32 TX to GPS RX (commands, RTCM corrections)
ESP32 RX from GPS TX (NMEA / UBX)
Leave disconnected on the GPS board
Nothing: all 5 pads on the header are wired.
The board drawing: Component side from its dimensioned drawing, turned a quarter turn anticlockwise so the
header (along its top edge) faces the SuperMini. Not to scale.
Every pin is 3.3 V logic, so no level shifting is needed: the hook-up ten64 used.
RXD is the board's input and TXD its output: GPIO4 (TX) goes to RXD, GPIO3 (RX) to TXD.
Default UART speed is 9600 baud. Takes RTCM 2.3 corrections only.
